department: MIT-WHOI Joint Program in Oceanography / Applied Ocean Science and Engineering

deadline.value: PhD/ScD applications due December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (opens October 1). Take the English test at least two weeks before the deadline.
deadline.quote: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time (PhD/ScD applicants)

english_waiver.value: The Joint Program grants no English-test waivers; Indian applicants must submit TOEFL/IELTS (exemptions only for 4-year degrees from Australia, Canada, Ireland, NZ, UK or US).
english_waiver.quote: The MIT-WHOI Joint Program does not grant English Language Proficiency test waivers.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the OGE page; the Joint Program admissions site (mit.whoi.edu) could not be fetched.

funding.value: Students are admitted with full funding (stipend, single health insurance, tuition).
funding.quote: Joint Program (JP) students are admitted to the program with full funding (i.e., stipend, health insurance for a single person, and tuition).

entry_route.value: MIT does not require a master's degree to apply for a PhD; you can apply from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may be admitted if the degree is awarded before enrolment).
entry_route.quote: The Institute does not require applicants to hold a master’s or other advanced degree in order to apply to a Ph.D program.

notes: Joint MIT and Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution doctoral programme; affiliated with Aero/Astro, Biology, CEE, EAPS, EECS and MechE. mit.whoi.edu/admissions returned 502.
